crankExecute(uint256[]).details: Reverts when the batch is non-empty and NOTHING executed. Without that,      gas estimation converges on an amount where every inner call gas-starves      inside the try/catch while the outer transaction "succeeds" — the revert      forces estimators to find a gas limit under which at least one forfeit      actually lands (found live in the anvil integration run).

slash(bytes,bytes,uint256[]).details: Public-values layout (v1, must match the challenger guest):      `abi.encode(address operator, bytes32 faultDigest)` where `faultDigest`      uniquely identifies the offense (e.g. keccak of the equivocating task digest      and the faithful output hash). Kept in one decode site for guest evolution.

params.commitmentIds: commitments to open forfeits on; each must be bound to the                       accused operator. Individual failures (e.g. an already-pending                       forfeit) are skipped and surfaced as events, but at least one                       forfeit must open.

activateVkey().notice: Activate a proposed vkey after its timelock. Permissionless: activation is         mechanical once the delay every operator could exit within has elapsed.

adapter().notice: Schnorr lifecycle adapter used for immediate ejection (one-shot wire).

cancelForfeit(uint256).notice: Guardian veto for a pending forfeit — proof-bug insurance; proofs are         objective so this should never fire in normal operation.

commitmentManager().notice: The CommitmentManager this arbiter dispatches forfeits to (IArbiter).

crankExecute(uint256[]).notice: Crank `executeForfeit` for elapsed challenge windows. Permissionless         convenience over the manager's own permissionless entry point.

guardian().notice: Governance for vkey rotation, forfeit cancellation, and metadata.

operatorRegistry().notice: Commitments operator registry (one-shot wire; see deploy order above).

slash(bytes,bytes,uint256[]).notice: Slash on a verified SP1 fraud proof. Permissionless: the proof is the         authority. Opens a forfeit on every supplied commitment bound to the accused         operator (self-stake and delegations — the caller enumerates ids off-chain         from registry events; `operatorForCommitment` makes the list trustless) and         ejects the operator's Schnorr key immediately.

slashMore(bytes32,uint256[]).notice: Open forfeits for additional commitments under an already-recorded offense         (delegations discovered after the original slash). Permissionless.

slashPenaltyBps().notice: Penalty applied per proven offense, in basis points of each commitment.

vkeyDelay().notice: Seconds a proposed vkey must wait before activation. Size it >= the         operator exit path (unbonding period + Schnorr notice window) so no key can         be slashed by a program it never had the chance to exit ahead of.

wireService(address,address).notice: One-shot wiring of the Commitments registry and the Schnorr adapter,         breaking the deploy cycle around the registry's immutable `requiredArbiter`.
